message: Desk 0.1.43 follows a Tools sign-in onto the shop page. If Tools is a different person, Firefox gets that person's gate and the open shop tab reloads. Home and the PIN screen leave for that person. Create R/O auto-print is unchanged.
chromiumMessage: Click Download update, unzip Black.Forest.Desk-chromium.zip over your Desk folder, then press Reload Desk.
